name: Ox-Body Technique

variants.label: One -1 and one -2 level
variants.description: Gain one extra -1 and one extra -2 health level.

description: The Dragon-Blooded may buy extra health levels as if they were a Charm. Each level (purchase) grants one -1 and one -2 health level. May be bought at most once per dot of Endurance.

name: Unsleeping Earth Meditation
description: By invoking the strength of the Earth Dragon, a Dragon-Blooded can go without sleep for 24 hours without ill effect, suffering no fatigue penalties from sleeplessness and remaining fully alert (she still must rest from physical exertion). Using it for more than the character's Essence + Endurance days is unwise: for every day past that point she loses one temporary Willpower per day, which cannot be recovered until she has had at least 24 hours of uninterrupted sleep.

name: Uneating Earth Meditation
description: Stone does not need nourishment, and with this Charm neither do the Dragon-Blooded. The character need not eat or drink and suffers none of the penalties of hunger. Using it for more than her Essence + Endurance days is hard on the body: for every day past that point she loses one bashing health level per day, which cannot be healed until the Charm is discontinued. Most who use it for extended periods go without its effects for a day or two before reinvoking it.

name: Unbreathing Earth Meditation
description: The mountains do not breathe, and neither need a Dynast who has mastered this Charm. For the rest of the scene the Dragon-Blood does not breathe, surviving underwater, in clouds of poison gas, and in other asphyxiating environments with no ill effect. For the duration she is incapable of breathing, so speech is impossible (its sound is made by expelled air). It can be used on a willing other by simply touching him.

name: Untiring Earth Meditation
description: Roots the Dragon-Blooded's Essence down into the elemental Earth, magically sustaining him. As long as his feet touch the earth once every two turns, he incurs no fatigue whatsoever from any source — armor, encumbrance, great exertion, or magical effect (it does not relieve fatigue already present when invoked). He may also ignore wound penalties up to his permanent Essence rating. If he does not touch the earth at least once every two turns, the Charm is instantly disrupted.

name: Unfeeling Earth Meditation
description: The pain and frailty of mortal flesh may be avoided for short periods. Once active, the character may ignore all wound penalties for a number of turns equal to his Stamina + Endurance. This does nothing to actually protect him from damage — it only temporarily alleviates the symptoms of injury.

name: Unflagging Vengeance Meditation
description: The steady strength of the Earth Dragon fuels the inner flame of vengeance. Invoked by speaking aloud the terms of a vendetta — a simply stated purpose ('Find the person who killed my father') — to which the character commits with all his soul. Until the vendetta is fulfilled, so long as he pursues it, he need not eat, sleep, or rest, incurs no fatigue (magical or natural) and none from armor, may soak both lethal and bashing with his Stamina, and adds his Endurance to both soaks. It can be sustained without ill effect for up to his Essence in days; after that he loses one unsoakable bashing health level each time his Essence in days passes (healable only after the Charm lapses, and at twice the usual rate). Additional characters up to his Essence may join by each paying 1 temporary Willpower. It ends when the vendetta is satisfied or he consciously stops it; anyone who terminates their oath prematurely takes unsoakable lethal damage equal to the sum of the permanent Essences of all involved, unreducible by any means.
